message.content: The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is the gas giant **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius roughly **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter**, making it one of the most massive and inflated exoplanets discovered. (Other very large exoplanets include WASP‑17b and HAT‑P‑32b, but HD 100546 b remains the record‑holder in terms of size.)
